name: fishy
description: FISHY: a Chrome extension that spots social-engineering scams in Meet and Gmail and calls the real person before money moves.

scripts.build: npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w extension && npm run test -w functions && node --test "scripts/tests/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w functions && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
